text:
maya: Heads-up - bringing up q4b-small-v2 on perf harness. Need curated prompt intake + dedupe before quant smoke. Targets: 10k eval / 1k holdout / 500 golden (senior) / 200 regression. Multi-domain, token-dist parity with prod.
dan: Dedupe strategy? suffix-preserving or full-normalized? Tokenizer mismatch caused weird drops last time.
maya: going suffix-preserving + tokenizer-normalize. Normalize whitespace/punc then hash last 512 tokens (64-bit). Example: ./ingest_prompts.py --src s3://redwood-prompt-bank/incoming/onboard/ --normalize tokenizer --dedupe suffix --suffix-tokens 512 --out s3://redwood-ingest/q4b_small_v2/ingest.ndjson
sophia: I'll create golden labeling batch. Schema: intent / format / severity / expected_acceptance (y/n) / hallucination_flag. Should we preserve model response for regression labeling?
maya: yes. add boolean preserve_response. Golden -> senior-labelers only. Label taxonomy: intent, slot-filling, multi-turn-coherence, safety.
arun: Quant prep note: trim very long prompts but preserve suffix markers. Cap at 2048 tokens for quant smoke and insert sentinel <END_CTX> before truncation to keep end signals. Helps KV-cache stability for INT8.
liam: After dedupe I'll run quick baselines: BLEU/ROUGE + log-perplexity gap vs float32 and token histograms to check skew.
labeling-bot: Created LB-3421 (500 golden) assigned team:senior-labelers ETA 48h.
sophia: labeling config set: priority=high, reviewer_required=true, preserve_response=true, regression_case_field=regression_case, deid_check=enabled. Adding a 50-case safety-heavy mini-cohort.
dan: Timeline: ingest + dedupe Tue morning, QA Tue afternoon, assign Wed morning, labels by Fri EOD, smoke Mon. Can we accelerate?
maya: Proposed accelerate: ingest Tue morning, dedupe Tue afternoon, assign Wed morning, small holdout Wed evening (1k), quant smoke Thu morning. Fallback: run smoke on 2k auto-curated subset if golden backlog. :white_check_mark:
ops-bot: deploy-bot scheduled smoke run q4b-small-v2 @ 2026-03-26T10:00:00Z (job id: smoke-8732).
liam: I'll post bench summary (latency/cost/perf deltas) after first run. If you have edge-domain prompts add to intake S3 by EOD Mon.
maya: thanks everyone 10. ping me for schema examples or ingest manifest. intake doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/onboard/prompt-harnessing (see ingest section).
